configuration.secrets: [if(parameters('enableKeyVaultSecret'), createArray(createObject('name', parameters('keyVaultSecretName'), 'identity', parameters('identityId'), 'keyVaultUrl', format('https://{0}{1}/secrets/{2}', parameters('keyVaultName'), environment().suffixes.keyvaultDns, parameters('keyVaultSecretName')))), createArray())]

containers.name: [parameters('name')]
containers.env: [if(not(empty(parameters('postgresHost'))), createArray(createObject('name', 'PGHOST', 'value', parameters('postgresHost')), createObject('name', 'PGPORT', 'value', '5432'), createObject('name', 'PGDATABASE', 'value', parameters('postgresDatabase')), createObject('name', 'PGUSER', 'value', parameters('postgresUser')), createObject('name', 'PGSSLMODE', 'value', 'require'), createObject('name', 'IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID', 'value', parameters('postgresClientId'))), createArray())]

containers.name: [parameters('name')]
containers.env: [if(not(empty(parameters('postgresHost'))), createArray(createObject('name', 'PGHOST', 'value', parameters('postgresHost')), createObject('name', 'PGPORT', 'value', '5432'), createObject('name', 'PGDATABASE', 'value', parameters('postgresDatabase')), createObject('name', 'PGUSER', 'value', parameters('postgresUser')), createObject('name', 'PGSSLMODE', 'value', 'require'), createObject('name', 'IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID', 'value', parameters('postgresClientId'))), createArray())]

metadata.description: Application names used by Log Analytics queries.
Azure Files file service resource IDs.

properties.description: Container App replica restart count exceeded the POC threshold.
PostgreSQL active connections exceeded the configured POC threshold.
PostgreSQL storage utilization exceeded the configured threshold.
Azure Files bandwidth utilization exceeded the configured threshold.
Azure Files capacity utilization exceeded the configured threshold.
Detects Container Apps revision provisioning errors for configured applications.

allOf.query: [format('ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where Log_s has "Error provisioning revision" | where ContainerAppName_s in ("{0}") | summarize Count=count()', join(parameters('applicationNames'), '","'))]

properties.displayName: ACA health or readiness probe failure
properties.description: Detects Container Apps system log messages indicating health or readiness probe failure.

allOf.query: [format('ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s in ("{0}") | where Log_s has_any ("health probe", "readiness probe", "liveness probe") and Log_s has_any ("failed", "failure", "unhealthy") | summarize Count=count()', join(parameters('applicationNames'), '","'))]
